tweets.text: Higgsfield's $400M Series B values the generative media startup at $5.4B, quadrupling from its $1.3B valuation months earlier. DST Global led.
Gravis Robotics raised $200M in Series A from SoftBank, sole investor. The Zurich-based voice AI firm attracted a single large check.
Muon Space closed $250M Series C, reaching $1.5B valuation. Google and Salesforce Ventures backed the Mountain View satellite infrastructure firm.
Castelion secured over $1B in structured financing from Carlyle, JPMorgan Chase and Andreessen Horowitz, including $250M credit facility.
Rillet raised $100M Series C at $1B valuation, led by ICONIQ. The mobility and robotics startup now has over $200M total funding.
Navi landed $100M in its first institutional financing from Prosus at $1.3B valuation. The Bengaluru fintech prepares for eventual IPO.
Network Bio launched with $50M from Section 32, Thiel Bio and others, linking biobanks to train disease-specific AI systems.
Velaura AI raised $110M Series A at over $1B valuation, led by Seligman Ventures. The power-efficient compute startup attracts semiconductor backers.
Abcuro closed $66M Series D led by New Leaf Venture Partners, with Bain Capital Life Sciences, RA Capital and Sanofi Ventures joining.
Apollo Atomics, MIT spinoff, closed oversubscribed $31M seed led by FCVC. Y Combinator and Robinhood Ventures backed the nuclear tech startup.
MaxQ Medical raised $31.5M Series A from Atlantic Blue Ventures, S3 Ventures and Olympus Innovation Ventures for surgical urology technology.
Quartr closed 15.6M euro Series A from Altos Ventures and SEB, adding to 7M seed. The Stockholm fintech offers AI-driven investment data.
ALSO closed $150M Series D led by Prysm Capital. The defense tech firm's robotics and advanced manufacturing play continues momentum.
AI-related assets now represent 16% of global private equity holdings, with physical infrastructure buildout still accelerating.
Evergreen fund assets topped $500B in 2026, driven by private credit growth. These structures now outperform closed-end PE and real estate peers.
Renaissance IPO Index up 18.6% year-to-date versus S&P 500 up 12.5%. CoreWeave and Astera Labs lead the index through August 20.
103 IPOs in 2026 through August 22. June peaked with 19 IPOs. Year-to-date count trails 2025's pace but momentum is building.
US IPO proceeds jumped 86% in Q1 2026 to $22B across 99 deals versus $11.8B across 84 IPOs in Q1 2025.
Traditional IPOs raised $114.1B through June 30, 2026, more than seven times the $14.8B in first half of 2025.
SPAC IPO issuance accelerated to highest level since 2021, with 118 SPAC IPOs raising $20.9B in first half versus $11.8B in same 2025 period.
Trade sales now represent 71% of private equity exit value in 2026 versus the historical 67%, as corporate acquirers hunt PE-backed assets.
Top quartile buyout funds achieved 24% IRR over the last decade, beating S&P 500's 15% and MSCI World's 13%.
Global IPO pipeline skews larger and later-stage, driven by financial sponsors exiting mature PE portfolios and broader sector participation.
Mega-deal concentration remains extreme: 2026 funding totals are record-setting while concentrated heavily among unicorns and mega-rounds.
